gate.signIn: Sign in to run your season.
gate.none: You do not run a season.
gate.noneBody: This desk is for a season's own admins, and a platform admin names them when the season is made or later. If you should run one, ask the platform's admins.
gate.notYoursBody: This desk is for the season's own admins and the platform's. These are the seasons you run:

none.title: {game} has no season to run yet.
none.body: A platform admin creates each season. Once one names you among its admins, it is here.

participants.title: Participants

openEntry.title: Anyone may enter this season.
openEntry.body: Its entry is open, so this list admits nobody extra and refuses nobody. It matters for a restricted season, and for who sees a private one.

participants.privateNote: This season is private: only the people on this list, its admins and the platform's admins can see it.
participants.pinnedTitle: Signed in: this login is the account @{handle}.
participants.waitingTitle: Not signed in yet. It is admitted the moment this login first signs in.

confirm.title: Remove {login}?
confirm.body: They can no longer submit to this season, and a private season stops showing to them. A version of theirs already on the ladder stays. You can add them again.

participants.empty: Nobody is on the list yet. Add logins below, one per line.
participants.emptyClosed: This season had nobody on its list.

add.placeholder: one login per line, or separated by commas

added.one: {n} added. A login already on the list is left as it is.
added.other: {n} added. A login already on the list is left as it is.

add.none: Every one of them was already on the list.

admins.title: Season admins

confirm.title: Remove @{handle} as an admin of this season?
confirm.body: They lose this desk at their next request, and the runner keys they minted for the season stop at their next call. They stay a competitor everywhere else.

admins.empty: This season has no admins of its own: the platform's admins run it.
admins.platformOnly: Only a platform admin names or removes a season's admins.

keys.title: Runner keys

revokeBody.one: Its {n} machine stops at its next token exchange, within ten minutes. A match it is playing is not cancelled.
revokeBody.other: Its {n} machines stop at their next token exchange, within ten minutes. A match one is playing is not cancelled.

keys.revokeUnused: No machine is using it. A revoked key cannot be used again, only replaced.
keys.empty: No key serves this season yet. Mint one below and start a runner with it.

mint.label: Label for a new key
mint.placeholder: Label: lab-gpu-1, a machine or a person

minted.title: Copy the key for {label} now.
minted.body: It serves this season and no other. We keep only its hash, so it cannot be shown again: if it is lost, revoke it and mint another. Set it as `RUNNER_KEY` on the machine.

runners.title: Runners
runners.stopBody: This machine alone stops at its next call, and its key keeps working for the others. A match it is playing is not cancelled: its lease lapses and another runner takes it.

title.one: {n} submission is waiting and nothing can admit it.
title.other: {n} submissions are waiting and nothing can admit them.

noAdmitter.own: This season admits on its own machines, and none of them has called in for the last minute or two. A waiting submission costs its owner no attempt, so nothing is lost yet — but it sits there until its deadline and is then refused for running out of time, which says nothing about the model. Start an admitting runner on one of this season's keys (`RUNNER_ROLE=admit`), or ask a platform administrator to let the platform fleet admit for this season.
noAdmitter.platform: This season admits on the platform's machines, and none of them has called in for the last minute or two. A waiting submission costs its owner no attempt, so nothing is lost yet — but it sits there until its deadline and is then refused for running out of time. Tell a platform administrator, or run an admitting runner on one of this season's own keys (`RUNNER_ROLE=admit`) and ask for the season to admit on its own machines too.
noAdmitter.both: Neither this season's machines nor the platform's have called in for the last minute or two. A waiting submission costs its owner no attempt, so nothing is lost yet — but it sits there until its deadline and is then refused for running out of time. Start an admitting runner on one of this season's keys (`RUNNER_ROLE=admit`), and tell a platform administrator.

engine.body: Not on this season's engine ({digest}): {runners}. A runner on another engine claims nothing and reports no error. Pin the season's ants release on the machine (`ANTS_RELEASE`) and restart it.

title.one: {n} runner is holding matches and not calling in.
title.other: {n} runners are holding matches and not calling in.

wedged.body: {runners}: silent for longer than the five-minute lease. Those claims lapse and another runner takes them. Stopping it keeps it from taking more.

runners.empty: No machine has used a key of this season yet.
runners.start: Start one: in a Kalam checkout, set `RUNNER_KEY` and `RUNNER_LABEL` in its `.env` and run `docker compose up -d`.

notify.title: Notify
notify.empty: Nothing has been sent to this season yet.

compose.subject: What to tell the season
compose.linkPlaceholder: A path on this site, such as /leaderboard?season=…
compose.who: Everyone who entered this season, its pinned participants and its admins, who take season notifications.

said.no_recipients: Nobody in the season would receive it yet: nobody has entered, and no participant has signed in.
said.notify_invalid: The subject is one line of 1 to 200 characters, and the link a path on this site starting with /.
said.season_admin_only: This account does not administer this season.
said.session_revoked: You are signed out. Sign in again and send it once more.

audit.title: Log
audit.empty: Nothing has happened to this season yet.
audit.emptyFiltered: Nothing in the log matches that action.
audit.moreFailed: The next page did not load. Try again.

said.season_admin_only: This account does not administer this season.
said.season_closed: The season has closed: its participants, admins and runners are fixed.
said.session_revoked: You are signed out. Sign in again and try once more.
said.unknown_participant: That participant is no longer on the list. The list has been read again.
said.handle_required: Give the handle of the account to add.
said.unknown_handle: No account has that handle. They must sign in once before they can run a season.
said.baseline_cannot_admin: A baseline account cannot run a season.
said.unknown_season_admin: They no longer run this season. The list has been read again.
said.admin_only: Only a platform admin names or removes a season's admins.
said.label_required: Give the key a label, so you can tell its machines apart later.
said.unknown_key: That key is no longer one of this season's live keys. The list has been read again.
said.unknown_runner: That runner is no longer one of this season's live runners. The list has been read again.
